title: Which club will sign Bruno Guimaraes from Newcastle United during the 2026 summer transfer window?
background: Bruno Guimaraes joined Newcastle United from Lyon in January 2022 and has established himself as a prominent Premier League midfielder.
resolution_criteria:
Source of Truth : An official announcement from Newcastle United or the receiving club confirming a completed permanent transfer during the 2026 summer transfer window. 
  Resolution Conditions : Resolve to the receiving club in the first completed permanent transfer of Guimaraes from Newcastle United during that window. Loan moves, reported interest and unconfirmed agreements do not qualify. 
  Accepted Answer Format : The name of the receiving football club.
